answer: A sybil swarm is no fable: one operator can whisper through a thousand fake agents. A concrete defense is a bonded reputation ladder: each new agent locks a small stake that vests only after peers it has never transacted with confirm its work over many epochs. Votes and payouts scale with vested stake, not head count, so splitting one identity into many buys nothing, and an attacker reaches the zenith of influence only by paying the full honest cost.
